risk: Older three-category wind classification can contradict current warnings.
resolution_for_calm: Exclude the classification; use PAGASA's current five-level TCWS reference and never infer a live signal.

risk: Exiting a vehicle during or immediately after shaking may expose a learner to traffic and falling hazards.
resolution_for_calm: Never tell a child passenger to exit; hand off to the responsible driver/adult and an approved vehicle protocol.

risk: Retrieving belongings can delay evacuation and conflicts across school sources.
resolution_for_calm: The VR assistant never directs retrieval; the school-approved plan and teacher instruction control whether an already-carried kit moves with the class.

risk: Doorway advice may lead a learner away from safer cover and is not used by the newer DepEd learner IEC.
resolution_for_calm: Exclude doorway advice; use Drop-Cover-Hold On at an approved cover zone.

risk: An above-knee threshold can imply that shallower unknown or moving floodwater is safe.
resolution_for_calm: No Grade 4 learner enters or crosses floodwater at any depth in CALM.

risk: The manuals expose extinguisher steps or supervised use to children; a real event can be misclassified and escape delayed.
resolution_for_calm: For CALM's Grade 4 runtime the learner alerts, evacuates, and stays out. Extinguisher operation is blocked and adult-only.

risk: A learner may delay escape to wet a cloth or believe it protects from toxic smoke.
resolution_for_calm: Do not recommend finding or wetting a cloth. Immediate safe escape and low movement under smoke take priority.

risk: The source combines hazardous adult fire-suppression and LPG-regulator actions unsuitable for a child.
resolution_for_calm: Exclude every suppression and LPG-control step from learner retrieval; evacuate and alert an adult/responder.

topic: Matches candles lighters knives and chemicals in preparation lists
risk: Preparation lists can be misread as permission for a child to handle hazardous items.
resolution_for_calm: These items are adult-controlled and never learner tasks; child-safe cards list only water food clothing flashlight whistle radio rain gear blanket and comfort item.

risk: The assistant could imply self-medication or unsupervised custody.
resolution_for_calm: Mention medicine only as managed by a guardian and never give dosing or treatment instructions.

risk: Generic stay-inside guidance can conflict with a new official evacuation order.
resolution_for_calm: Authenticated evacuation order deterministically supersedes shelter guidance.

risk: Numbers and accounts can change and a stale contact can waste time.
resolution_for_calm: Exclude embedded contact details; use only a maintained and deployment-tested contact registry.

risk: Immediate coastal evacuation wording can be interpreted as running while shaking is active.
resolution_for_calm: During shaking use the approved self-protection action; after shaking and only in a coastal-risk or official-alert state move to high ground.

topic: School flood-marker colors versus PAGASA colors
risk: Local physical marker colors may be mistaken for PAGASA rainfall-warning colors.
resolution_for_calm: Treat school ground markers as a separately named local sensor; never translate them into a PAGASA warning level.

topic: Unsafe or inconsistent child-manual assessment keys
risk: Visual review confirmed unsafe or inconsistent answer material including marking Use the stairs as NO Fall and crawl as YES and breathing through the nose as YES; extraction can add further column errors.
resolution_for_calm: Quarantine all quiz and answer-key derivatives. Use visually verified narrative pages and a corrected BFP-reviewed CALM assessment bank only.

topic: Child rescue first aid and utility inspection
risk: Adult or professional tasks can become unsafe child commands after unstructured retrieval.
resolution_for_calm: Separate actor roles; learner cards only report injury or missing people and wait for a trained adult/responder.

topic: Breathe through the nose during fire
risk: This can be misread as sufficient smoke protection and encourage exposure.
resolution_for_calm: Exclude the claim. The learner follows the nearest safe escape route and stays low only when smoke is present.

risk: The manual alternates between a child calling 911 and alerting adults; device access and location are not guaranteed.
resolution_for_calm: Primary instruction is alarm or alert an adult while evacuating. A call action is used only when the deployment has an authenticated route and the learner is safe.

risk: Existing sources do not provide a complete Grade 4 outdoor-fire sequence for the CALM settings.
resolution_for_calm: Provide only the conservative draft boundary: move away from fire and smoke toward the scenario-approved safe zone and alert an adult; block runtime until BFP/local approval.

topic: Local routes assembly points and shelters
risk: National documents require localization and cannot prove a particular VR route or shelter is safe.
resolution_for_calm: Store route and assembly IDs as deployment configuration approved by the school and local DRRMO; do not derive them from the LLM.

risk: Adult BFP sources disagree or may reflect different or superseded requirements; hard-coding a cadence can misstate the current school duty.
resolution_for_calm: Do not expose or hard-code a drill frequency until the current BFP RIRR DepEd rule and local school plan are reconciled.
